claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_acquisition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature has no activation, no resource, no reset cadence, and no concrete effect. Its entire purpose is to grant the character a subclass whose features are themselves separate units. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family (currently only 'activation') can encode this without fabricating fields that do not exist in the rule text. A new family — 'subclass_acquisition' or 'passive_grant' — is required to honestly represent one-time character-progression gates that delegate all downstream mechanics to another unit tree.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Wizard subclass of your choice. The Evoker subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Wizard levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Wizard level or lower.
